name: Melbourne
summary: Melbourne is Australia's culture capital, known for hidden laneway cafés and street art, great galleries and a passion for sport at the MCG. It's the start of the Great Ocean Road, and Phillip Island's little penguins come ashore nearby every evening.
seasonNote: March to May and October to December are mild and pleasant. Summer (January and February) can be very hot. Winter is cool and grey. The weather changes fast, so 'four seasons in one day' is a local joke.
arrival: Melbourne Airport is 30 minutes from the city by SkyBus. Flights from Sydney take about 1.5 hours; the overnight ferry runs to Tasmania.
gettingAround: Trams are free inside the city centre; tap on with a myki card outside it.
cashTip: Cards and tap payments work almost everywhere; tipping isn't expected.
foodTip: Flat whites, brunch, Vietnamese and Greek food, Italian on Lygon Street, and dumplings in Chinatown.
buyTip: Australian wine, design from local makers, Aboriginal art and Tim Tams.

connections.note: One of the world's busiest air routes.
